Sauce AI is the family of AI-powered capabilities across the Sauce Labs platform. It brings generative AI and AI-agent access to the tools you already use, so you can author tests in natural language, analyze results conversationally, explore application errors, and connect your own AI agents directly to the platform.

## Sauce AI for Test Authoring

Create, edit, manage, and run test cases at scale using natural-language prompts, with no code required. Sauce AI turns your test goals into structured, editable, runnable flows for web, mobile web, and native mobile applications on browsers, virtual devices, and real devices.

- [Sauce AI for Test Authoring](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/ai-authoring)
- [Generate a test case](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/test-authoring/generate-your-test-case)
- [Test Authoring in your IDE](https://docs.saucelabs.com/ide-plugins/ai-test-authoring)
- [Prompting guide](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/ai-authoring-prompting-guide)

## Sauce AI for Insights

An intuitive natural-language agent built into the Sauce Home experience. Ask questions about your test data (pass rates, recurring errors, flaky devices) and get tailored answers, visualizations, and reports in seconds.

- [Sauce AI for Insights](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/ai-insights)
- [Automated bug troubleshooting](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/ai-insights/automated-bug-troubleshooting)
- [Privacy, safety, and trust](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/ai-insights/privacy-safety-and-trust)
- [Prompting guide](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/ai-insights-prompting-guide)

## Sauce AI for Error Reporting

Explore application crashes and errors by describing what you are looking for. Sauce AI applies the right filters, adjusts the timeframe, and groups the matching error data in the Explore view.

- [Sauce AI for Error Reporting](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/error-reporting/overview)
- [Explore error data using Sauce AI](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/error-reporting/error-reporting-using-sauce-ai)
- [Prompting guide](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/prompting-guides/error-reporting)

## Sauce MCP

Connect your AI assistant or agent to Sauce Labs through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Discover devices, run real-device sessions, install apps, capture screenshots and logs, inspect jobs and builds, and author and run tests, all in natural language, from the AI tools you already use.

- [Sauce MCP overview](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/sauce-mcp)
- [Connect your AI client](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/sauce-mcp-getting-started)
- [Tools](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/sauce-mcp-tools)
- [Prompting guide](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/real-device-cloud-mcp-prompting-guide)

## Get Better Results with Prompting Guides [​](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/index.html\#get-better-results-with-prompting-guides "Direct link to Get Better Results with Prompting Guides")

Every Sauce AI capability responds to natural language, and clear, specific prompts produce more accurate results. Use the prompting guide for the capability you are working with:

- **[AI Authoring Prompting Guide](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/ai-authoring-prompting-guide/)**: Describe user actions, request assertions, and use Data Variables when generating tests.
- **[AI Insights Prompting Guide](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/ai-insights-prompting-guide/)**: Ask focused questions about your test data.
- **[AI Error Reporting Prompting Guide](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/prompting-guides/error-reporting/)**: Query crashes and errors in plain language.
- **[Real Device Cloud Prompting Guide](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/real-device-cloud-mcp-prompting-guide/)**: Ready-to-use prompts for Sauce MCP.

## Privacy and Trust [​](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/index.html\#privacy-and-trust "Direct link to Privacy and Trust")

Sauce AI is designed to minimize the data it sends to the model. Sauce AI for Insights mirrors the data access you already have elsewhere in the platform, and Sauce AI for Test Authoring never sends **[Data Variable](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/test-authoring/data-variables/#how-variable-values-are-protected)** values to the AI model. For details on how data is handled, see **[Privacy, Safety, and Trust](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/ai-insights/privacy-safety-and-trust/)** and the **[Responsible use of AI guidelines](https://trust.saucelabs.com/resources?s=tcd1vcgj9ya80ahtrhj65&name=responsible-usage-of-ai-at-sauce-labs)** in the **[Sauce Labs Trust Center](https://trust.saucelabs.com/)**.

- [Get Better Results with Prompting Guides](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/index.html#get-better-results-with-prompting-guides)
- [Privacy and Trust](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/index.html#privacy-and-trust)
